input.headline: B.Fernandes hits a hat-trick as Man Utd rout Ipswich Town

cards.title: Man Utd ran riot against Ipswich
cards.text: The 5-2 win was a bonanza for owners. B.Fernandes posted the best individual score of the season so far.
Haaland's brace at Crystal Palace rewarded the armband, yet those who trusted B.Fernandes with it did even better.
The bandwagon stalled as Brighton conceded 4 at Chelsea, while Gibbs-White punished the managers who sold him.

cards.title: City's double act
cards.text: Cherki (14 points) edged out Haaland (13 points), with both scoring twice in the away win.

items.text: hauled with an assist for his 41.9% of owners
has now gone 2 gameweeks in a row without minutes
